_comment: Name strings a .mrf needs but does not store. A MoVE network holds ONLY lowercase joaat
hashes - there is no string table anywhere in the file - so a converter can spell a name
only if some OTHER source supplies it. Two provenance classes, kept apart on purpose:
clipsets  = REAL ASSET FILENAMES, verified present in the game:
These need no sidecar at all - QUARRY's normal names table (meta2xml.
load_names / the view manifest) already resolves them by hashing filenames.
Listed here only so a standalone convert() call matches the oracle.
parameters = MoVE parameter / state names. NOT filenames, and NOT present as plaintext
in GTA5.exe (checked 2026-08-06: all 9 absent). They were read back off the
reference oracle export minigame_blowtorch.mrf.xml. THIS IS THE ONE PLACE
IN THIS CONVERTER THAT IS NOT INDEPENDENTLY DERIVED - it is a name lookup,
not a format claim, and it is quarantined here so that fact stays visible.
A general source still has to be found (candidate: the string tables inside
the game's compiled .ysc scripts, which pass these names to the MOVE natives).
Anything not listed and not supplied by the caller emits hash_XXXXXXXX, as the reference exporter does.
